description: MCP servers this runtime ships with. A workspace overrides any of them, and adds its own, in .mcp.json or .agent/mcp.json; the environment variable MCP_SERVERS wins over both. Four transports are available: stdio for a local process, http for Streamable HTTP, sse for the older HTTP+SSE pair, and websocket. The transport is inferred from a command or a url when it is not stated.
